meanings.meaning: A wooden bar laid on the necks of work animals like oxen so they can pull a plow or load together. To yoke animals is to put this bar on them.
A pair of oxen joined together by a yoke. It can also mean the amount of land such a pair could plow in a day.

A picture of heavy rule, slavery, or a hard burden. Having a yoke put on you means being under someone's control. Removing it pictures being set free, while breaking it can also mean refusing to obey an authority.
